lines.en: We board a bus that’s moving backwards and all I can think about is the sound the tires make.
lines.zh: 我们登上一辆正在倒退的公交,而我满脑子只有轮胎的声音。

lines.en: It’s a low pitched hum, not far dissimilar to the sound of a hummingbird’s wings as they defy what we’ve come to expect of some of the creatures living in the same world as us.
lines.zh: 那是一种低沉的嗡鸣,与蜂鸟振翅的声音相差无几——那种小小的生灵,公然违抗我们对其同世同侪的一切预期。

lines.en: Soon, the night will come.
lines.zh: 很快,夜就要来了。

lines.en: It will replace the sun and shift the tide, dragging many creatures back into the shallowest parts of the ocean- some willing, some not.
lines.zh: 它将取代太阳、牵动潮汐,把无数生灵拖回海洋最浅的地方——有的自愿,有的不然。

lines.en: We take a seat in the back and look into each other’s eyes.
lines.zh: 我们在后排坐下,彼此凝视。

lines.en: I take Ami’s hands in my own and observe the minor gashes she obtained while trying to do something good.
lines.zh: 我把 Ami 的手捧在手心,端详着她为做一件好事而留下的小小割伤。

lines.en: They open back up and leak out the only fluid meant to be kept in.
lines.zh: 伤口重新裂开,漏出那唯一被规定必须留在体内的液体。

lines.en: I press my tongue to them and drink in her existence.
lines.zh: 我把舌尖按上去,啜饮她的存在。

lines.en: A warmth floods over me like a ray of sunlight made weaker by a bedsheet.
lines.zh: 一股暖流涌遍全身,像一缕被床单削弱过的阳光。

lines.en: : Do you believe in God, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你信神吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 你信吗?

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我信。

lines.en: : Maya makes fun of me for it sometimes, but I think that he’s real.
lines.zh: : Maya 有时会笑话我,但我觉得祂是真的。

lines.en: : I don’t know if he’s watching every second of every day, but I think he’s there.
lines.zh: : 我不知道祂是否时时刻刻都在注视,但我觉得祂在那里。

lines.en: : And I think that all of the suffering that you and I have endured is just his way of testing us.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得,你我承受过的所有苦难,只是祂考验我们的方式。

lines.en: : Testing us for what?
lines.zh: : 考验我们什么?

lines.en: : Testing us for wh-
lines.zh: : 考验我们什——

lines.en: : It is a test to see if we are worthy of Heaven.
lines.zh: : 考验我们配不配得上天堂。

lines.en: : To see if we can endure the harshness of reality and overcome adversity in order to gain one of the many limited seats in the giant sky castle all good boys and girls go to when they die.
lines.zh: : 看我们能不能扛住现实的严酷、跨越逆境,好赢得那座巨大天空之城里的一个限定席位——所有好孩子死后都会去的地方。

lines.en: : Will you sit with me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你会和我一起坐吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Will you come to the sky castle with me?
lines.zh: : 你会和我一起去天空之城吗?

lines.en: We talk at length about the afterlife while swapping seats in the classroom.
lines.zh: 我们长谈来世,同时在天教室里交换座位。

lines.en: Ami breathes in a sequence that is easily decoded. She is trying to communicate with me in a secret language we devised when we weren’t as tattered.
lines.zh: Ami 的呼吸有着一眼可解的韵律。她在试图用一种我们尚未破败时设计的密语和我交流。

lines.en: One. Two. One. Four. Eight.
lines.zh: 一。二。一。四。八。

lines.en: The amount of seconds between breaths. It moves from side to side, neglecting all that is in the middle.
lines.zh: 呼吸之间的秒数。它左右移动,跳过中间的一切。

lines.en: It’s like an abacus, in that sense.
lines.zh: 从这个意义上说,它像一把算盘。

lines.en: I’m like an abacus in that sense.
lines.zh: 从这个意义上说,我也像一把算盘。

lines.en: The parts of me furthest away from the center are the ones that do the most work.
lines.zh: 离中轴最远的部分,干的活最多。

lines.en: Everything in the middle is just blank.
lines.zh: 中间的一切,一片空白。

lines.en: : Do you ever wonder where we go when we die?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过,我们死后会去哪?

lines.en: : Is it not the sky castle you were alluding to in the sentences prior to this?
lines.zh: : 不就是你前几句话暗示的那座天空之城吗?

lines.en: : Do you ever wonder anything at all?
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有想过任何事情?

lines.en: : I wonder about all sorts of things.
lines.zh: : 我会想各种各样的事。

lines.en: : Tell me.
lines.zh: : 说给我听。

lines.en: : Tell me the things you think about on bus rides backwards.
lines.zh: : 把你在倒退的公交上想的事,说给我听。

lines.en: I remove a list from my pocket that I always keep on hand in the event that someone asks me this question.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里抽出一张清单——我随身带着它,就是为了应对有人问这个问题。

lines.en: I begin to read from it.
lines.zh: 我开始念。

lines.en: : When I was younger, I used to take the tips of my thumb and my index finger and make a ring out of them.
lines.zh: : 小时候,我常用拇指和食指的指尖,圈出一个环。

lines.en: : I’d wrap the ring around my ankle and, as the years went by, I stopped being able to fit all of it inside.
lines.zh: : 我会把那个环套在脚踝上;随着年岁增长,我再也塞不进去了。

lines.en: : I think it was when I could no longer close the ring anymore that I realized I was unhappy.
lines.zh: : 我想,就是在我再也无法合拢那个环的时候,我意识到——我不快乐。

lines.en: : It was good to be growing, but what if I was growing too much?
lines.zh: : 长大是好事。可我要是长得太过了呢?

lines.en: : Tell me the things you think about, Ami.
lines.zh: : 说说你都在想什么,Ami。

lines.en: : On bus rides backwards, I like to think about us.
lines.zh: : 在倒退的公交上,我喜欢想我们。

lines.en: : Us?
lines.zh: : 我们?

lines.en: I ask her, “Us?”
lines.zh: 我反问:「我们?」

lines.en: : Us.
lines.zh: : 我们。

lines.en: : Like...“is this really working?”
lines.zh: : 就像……「这样真的行得通吗?」

lines.en: : Is what working?
lines.zh: : 什么行得通?

lines.en: : You and me at arm’s distance.
lines.zh: : 相隔一臂之距的你和我。

lines.en: : I’ve done almost all I can and yet you’re still so far away.
lines.zh: : 我几乎已经竭尽所能,而你依然那么遥远。

lines.en: : Is that really going to work?
lines.zh: : 这样真的行得通吗?

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 为什么行不通?

lines.en: : Because neither of us are happy.
lines.zh: : 因为我们俩都不幸福。

lines.en: : Would changing the proximity of our physical distance truly work in adjusting that?
lines.zh: : 改变物理距离的远近,真的能调整那个吗?

lines.en: : It would bring us closer. Literally.
lines.zh: : 至少会让我们更近。字面意义上的。

lines.en: : We’re not meant to be apart.
lines.zh: : 我们本就不该分开。

lines.en: : We’re meant to sit in the sky castle together.
lines.zh: : 我们本该一起坐在天空之城里。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: One. Two. One. Four. Eight.
lines.zh: 一。二。一。四。八。

lines.en: The pattern stays the same.
lines.zh: 规律没有变。

lines.en: An onslaught of footsteps approaches from directly behind me, but there’s not enough room in here to move my head.
lines.zh: 一阵密集的脚步声从我正后方逼近,但车里没有空间让我转头。

lines.en: I also fear that it would fall off of my shoulders if I were to try.
lines.zh: 而且我怕一动,脑袋会从肩膀上掉下来。

lines.en: : Next stop: Somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 下一站:别处。

lines.en: : If I asked you to start reading me bedtime stories before I go to sleep, would you?
lines.zh: : 如果我请你在我睡前给我读睡前故事,你会读吗?

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Sensei。

lines.en: : The sound of your voice always puts me at ease.
lines.zh: : 你的声音总能让我安心。

lines.en: : I particularly enjoy the way you enunciate わ and how it always sounds as if you are breathing a sigh of relief when saying my name.
lines.zh: : 我尤其喜欢你的「わ」的发音——每次念到我的名字,听起来都像在松一口气。

lines.en: : Like you are glad that I still exist in a form that you can talk about without slipping your hands into your pockets.
lines.zh: : 像是庆幸我还存在,还拥有一个你可以谈论的形态——不至于让你把手伸进口袋。

lines.en: : When you grasp at the fabric inside of them, do you ever find holes?
lines.zh: : 当你在口袋里攥紧那些布料时,你有没有摸到过洞?

lines.en: : Does anything ever fall through?
lines.zh: : 有什么东西从指缝里漏下去过吗?

lines.en: The bus ride continues and I watch the clouds through the windows of a well lit church.
lines.zh: 公交继续前行(或者后退),我透过一座灯火通明的教堂的窗户,看云。

lines.en: I can smell candles scented with something reminiscent of the earliest years of my life, though it could just be dying wax.
lines.zh: 我能闻到蜡烛的气味,那香气让我想起此生最初的岁月——虽然那也可能只是蜡烛垂死的蜡味。

lines.en: Ami’s hands open up again, but she smears the blood onto a pew built of concrete before sending signals to her brain that cause her eyes to tilt in the direction of mine.
lines.zh: Ami 的手再次裂开,但她把血抹在一张混凝土长椅上,然后向大脑发送信号,让眼睛转向我的方向。

lines.en: : I can feel it, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我感觉得到,Sensei。

lines.en: : I can feel His light.
lines.zh: : 我感觉得到祂的光。

lines.en: : And though it isn’t mine to hold, I want nothing more than to wrap my arms around it. I want nothing more than to be swallowed by it.
lines.zh: : 虽然它并不属于我,但我别无所求,只想张开双臂抱住它。别无所求,只想被它吞没。

lines.en: : I love you so much.
lines.zh: : 我太爱你了。

lines.en: : Will you tell me you love me too?
lines.zh: : 你也会说你爱我吗?

lines.en: : Of course. I love you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 当然。我爱你,Ami。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Sensei。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Sensei。

lines.en: : That was a really random time to say that, but I love you too.
lines.zh: : 这时候说这个还真突兀,不过我也爱你。

lines.en: : Are you feeling any better now?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉好些了吗?

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : What do you mean, “What do you mean?”
lines.zh: : 你问「什么意思」是什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean what do you mean?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,你说的「什么意思」是什么意思?

lines.en: : I don’t know what you mean.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你什么意思。

lines.en: Ami lovingly caresses a giant chicken as the bus begins to move faster.
lines.zh: 公交开始加速,Ami 满怀爱意地抚摸着一只巨大的鸡。

lines.en: It stops at so many different places and I can’t help but applaud the constant advancement in modern transportation technology.
lines.zh: 它在无数个不同的地方停靠,让我忍不住为现代交通技术的持续进步鼓掌。

lines.en: One. Two. One. Four. Eight. Yet the middle parts drop out again as she points me to a chair.
lines.zh: 一。二。一。四。八。可当她把我引向一把椅子时,中间的部分又掉了出去。

lines.en: I sit down on it and can’t help but feel like I’m usurping the role of king from an invisible entity who doesn’t want me to sit here.
lines.zh: 我坐上去,却忍不住觉得:自己正在从一个看不见的存在手里篡夺王座——而它不想让我坐在这里。

lines.en: Ami brings herself down to her knees and kisses my feet.
lines.zh: Ami 屈膝跪下,亲吻我的脚。

lines.en: : This will help you walk.
lines.zh: : 这能帮你走路。

lines.en: Her tongue slips out like a clam searching for salt.
lines.zh: 她的舌头滑出来,像一只寻找盐分的蚌。

lines.en: She laps up the effort I place into tainting sacred grounds and dirties herself in the process, but at least my feet are clean now.
lines.zh: 她舔舐着我玷污圣地所付出的努力,也把自己弄得脏污不堪——但至少,我的脚干净了。

lines.en: Her tongue dissolves into a sludge that seeps back into her throat only to ooze out of every pore and, in that moment, looks more beautiful than I have ever seen before.
lines.zh: 她的舌头融化成污泥,渗回喉咙,又从每一个毛孔里涌出;在那一瞬间,她美得超过我此前所见的一切。

lines.en: The ooze seeps back into her flesh before it seizes the opportunity to drip onto the ground of an area undiscovered before its ultimate absorption provokes the budding of a thousand eyes.
lines.zh: 那些黏液渗回她的血肉,却在彻底被吸收之前抓住机会滴落地面,滴进一片从未被发现的地域——并催发了上千只眼睛的萌发。

lines.en: : Do you believe in God, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你信神吗,Sensei?

lines.en: She asks again, but the beauty before me eliminates any chance I have to deny it once more.
lines.zh: 她又问了一遍,但眼前的美,让我再一次失去了否认的机会。

lines.en: I am condemned by an entity unseen- the same one who granted her an ever-abundance of vision.
lines.zh: 我被一个看不见的存在定罪——正是那位赋予她无尽视线的存在。

lines.en: The condemnation carries with it a single letter carved out of wood that fuses to my back the same way my bed in the early morning had been.
lines.zh: 定罪附带一枚木刻的字母,它烙上我的背,一如清晨那张吸附我的床。

lines.en: I fall as I am unable to bear its weight but encounter a moment of tranquility when my path intertwines with that of a REAL HUMAN FEMALE.
lines.zh: 我跌倒了,扛不住它的重量;但在我的路与一位 REAL HUMAN FEMALE 交织的瞬间,我遇见了一刻宁静。

lines.en: : Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.
lines.zh: : 蒙大恩的女子,我问你安!主和你同在了。

lines.en: : Where? I can’t see him.
lines.zh: : 哪里?我看不见祂。

lines.en: : Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.
lines.zh: : 蒙大恩的女子,我问你安!主和你同在了。

lines.en: : Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.
lines.zh: : 蒙大恩的女子,我问你安!主和你同在了。

lines.en: : Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.
lines.zh: : 蒙大恩的女子,我问你安!主和你同在了。

lines.en: The REAL HUMAN FEMALE gets caught on repeat and my journey comes to an untimely demise.
lines.zh: REAL HUMAN FEMALE 卡在了循环里,我的旅程就此不明不白地终结。

lines.en: We board a bus that’s moving backwards and all I can think about is a spot on the window where the guts of a bug we crashed into are smeared.
lines.zh: 我们登上一辆正在倒退的公交,而我满脑子只有车窗上的一点污渍——我们撞死的一只虫子的内脏,糊在那里。

lines.en: Dried by the sun and picked partially clean by whatever predators dared to crawl upon an invisible barrier, the spot casts a small shadow upon Ami’s arm.
lines.zh: 被太阳晒干、被不知死活爬上隐形屏障的捕食者啃食掉一部分,那点污渍在 Ami 的手臂上投下小小的影子。

lines.en: In between the miniature hair follicles covering it, I imagine the bug springing back to life.
lines.zh: 在覆盖那片区域的细小毛孔之间,我幻想那只虫子活了过来。

lines.en: It’s blurred out, however, as I can not imagine what type of insect it was from just a stain alone.
lines.zh: 但画面是模糊的——仅凭一块污渍,我无法想象那究竟是哪种虫子。

lines.en: The bus continues on (Or off) and I drift in and out of consciousness at the command of violent glares brought on by the god in the sky.
lines.zh: 公交继续前行(或者后退),我在天空之神投来的凶狠注视中,一遍遍沉入又浮出意识。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: So I do believe after all.
lines.zh: 原来我终究还是信的。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I wish you knew how to drive.
lines.zh: : 有时候,真希望你会开车。

lines.en: : I think it would be nice to kind of just...drive around with you sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,要是能时不时和你一起开车出去,该有多好。

lines.en: : We wouldn’t have to go anywhere. Just being with you and taking in the sights would be enough.
lines.zh: : 我们不用去哪。只要和你待在一起,看看风景,就足够了。

lines.en: : We could listen to music on the radio and talk about the things we’re afraid of admitting in front of others.
lines.zh: : 我们可以听着电台里的音乐,聊那些不敢当着别人承认的事。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I wish you knew how to drive.
lines.zh: : 有时候,真希望你会开车。

lines.en: : Because it would give us something to do when everything else disappears.
lines.zh: : 因为等一切都消失的时候,那至少还能给我们留一件事做。

lines.en: : What do you mean, “When everything else disappears?”
lines.zh: : 「等一切都消失的时候」是什么意思?

lines.en: : Hm?
: Did you just wake up?
lines.zh: : 你刚醒吗?

lines.en: : If you thought I was asleep, who were you talking to just now?
lines.zh: : 你要是以为我在睡觉,那你刚才是在跟谁说话?

lines.en: : Sensei, I haven’t said anything this entire ride. You passed out the second we got on.
lines.zh: : Sensei,这一整路我什么都没说。上车那一刻你就昏过去了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : It’s obviously my fault for dragging you around all day, so I’m sorry if it was a little too much.
lines.zh: : 拉着你跑了一整天,肯定是我不好。要是有点过头了,对不起。

lines.en: : And your hand?
lines.zh: : 那你的手呢?

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 手怎么了?

lines.en: : Is it okay?
lines.zh: : 没事吧?

lines.en: : It's totally fine!
lines.zh: : 完全没事!

lines.en: : I guess the cuts from the glass weren’t really that deep since you can barely even see them anymore.
lines.zh: : 玻璃划的口子其实不深,你看,现在几乎都看不见了。
: 我……明白了……

lines.en: : It still stings a little, but I’m sure I’ll feel totally normal by tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 还有点刺刺的,不过到明天肯定就完全正常了。

lines.en: : Oh, which reminds me-
lines.zh: : 哦,对了,差点忘了——

lines.en: : Ami, I don’t think I have the energy required to go on an outing like this two days in a row.
lines.zh: : Ami,我大概没有连着两天进行这种出游所需的体力。

lines.en: : Actually, what I was about to tell you is that I’ll be working all day tomorrow and that you won’t need to put up with me at all.
lines.zh: : 其实,我想说的是:明天我要工作一整天,你完全不用忍受我。

lines.en: : All day? Did Uta call out or something?
lines.zh: : 一整天?Uta 请假了还是怎么了?

lines.en: : That’s the weird part. I got a text from Osako-chan while you were asleep saying that Uta hadn’t answered her phone all day.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的就这里。你睡着的时候,Osako 酱给我发消息说,Uta 一整天都没接电话。

lines.en: : She was supposed to work today, too, but she just kinda...didn’t show up.
lines.zh: : 她今天本来也要上班的,但她就……没出现。

lines.en: : So if that happens again tomorrow night and nobody is there to cover for her, the cafe will have to close early or something and that would probably be pretty bad for business.
lines.zh: : 所以要是明晚还这样、又没人替班,咖啡厅就得提前关门什么的,那对生意可相当糟糕。

lines.en: : I really hope she’s okay. She’s never done anything like this before.
lines.zh: : 真希望她没事。她以前从来没这样过。

lines.en: : Should we maybe go check on her?
lines.zh: : 要不要我们去看一眼?

lines.en: : If she’s not in school tomorrow, I think you should. I won’t have time, though, since I’ll have to go straight to work.
lines.zh: : 明天她要是没去上学,我觉得你该去看看。我就没时间了,得直接上班。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ll just text Io to- oh.
lines.zh: : 没事。我到时候问 Io——哦。

lines.en: : I guess I don’t get any service here.
lines.zh: : 这里好像没有信号。

lines.en: : Io? Since when do you have her number? I thought she didn’t talk to anybody except Uta?
lines.zh: : Io?你什么时候有她号码的?我记得她除了 Uta 谁都不理?

lines.en: : I am one of the very rare exceptions, I guess. But it looks like I’ll have to just ask her when we get home.
lines.zh: : 我大概就是那极少数的例外之一。不过看来只能回家后再问她了。

lines.en: : I guess so...
lines.zh: : 也好……

lines.en: : Sensei. Can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Sensei。我能问你一件事吗?

lines.en: : Sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 当然。怎么了?

lines.en: : Do you believe in God?
lines.zh: : 你信神吗?

lines.en: The bus continues on (Or off) and I drift in and out of consciousness at the command of violent glares brought on by the sky.
lines.zh: 公交继续前行(或者后退),我在天空投来的凶狠注视中,一遍遍沉入又浮出意识。

lines.en: Ami does the same, collapsing onto my shoulder at several points following a question that would have been better suited for someone else.
lines.zh: Ami 也一样,好几次瘫倒在我的肩上——每次都紧跟在一个更适合问别人的问题之后。

lines.en: Her skin feels much colder than normal and I wrap my arm around her to distribute some of my warmth.
lines.zh: 她的皮肤比平时冷得多,我用手臂环住她,分一些温度给她。

lines.en: Her breaths are unsteady. One. Two. One. Four. Eight.
lines.zh: 她的呼吸不稳。一。二。一。四。八。

lines.en: Her lungs can’t seem to decide what it is they should be doing.
lines.zh: 她的肺,好像拿不定主意自己该干什么。

lines.en: And my mind can’t seem to decide where it is that it should wander.
lines.zh: 而我的心,也好像拿不定主意该游荡到哪里。

lines.en: We get off the bus that’s moving backwards.
lines.zh: 我们下了那辆正在倒退的公交。

lines.en: And we bend ourselves until we wind up at our door.
lines.zh: 然后我们一路弯折,最终弯到了家门口。

lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
